news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.30 (vs ₹11.44 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.30 (down from ₹11.44 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹1.11b (up 8.4% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹79.2m (down 88% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 7.2% (down from 65% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 15% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 32% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.9% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (1.4x net interest cover). news.title: Future Market Networks Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 54.81 million in funding from Westfield Hygiene Private Limited
news.body: Future Market Networks Limited announces a private placement with Westfield Hygiene Private Limited to issue 100,000 Equity shares at a price of INR 10.80 per share for proceeds of INR 1,080,000 and 19,900,000 convertible Warrants at a price of INR 2.7 per share for gross proceeds of INR 53,730,000 for aggregate proceeds of INR 54,810,000 on May 19, 2026. Warrant exercise price is INR 8.1. This has been approved by Board of directors of the company.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.32 (vs ₹1.05 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.32 (down from ₹1.05 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹269.3m (up 1.9% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹19.5m (down 70% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 7.2% (down from 24% in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 22% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 17% per year.
